reason: This change redesigns the Project Switcher presentation while preserving Core-backed project catalog and archive state and URL-backed project selection. The SideNav component file contains 25 focused component tests for dialog focus, active and archived search, and create failure. The project-switcher-search catalog selects eight mocked browser profiles for responsive project search and one real-Core LAN journey for project selection and reload. CSS audit and production build are separate validation gates.
exclusions: Python backend and native Rust code are unchanged. Unrelated UI journeys and catalog areas are excluded. The selected browser entries cover desktop 1440 px, compact 1024 px, mobile Chromium 320/390/430 px, mobile WebKit 320/390/430 px, and the real-Core LAN journey. Mobile profiles use browser emulation; no physical devices are available.
